name: accueil-clair
script: (() => { const rail = document.querySelector('.rail'); const cats = rail.querySelectorAll('a[href^="/categories/"]'); const counts = [...rail.querySelectorAll('a[href^="/categories/"] .rail-count')].map(c => Number(c.textContent)); const crumb = document.querySelector('.top-bar .crumb')?.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, ''); const ok = cats.length === 10 && counts.every(n => n > 0) && Math.round(rail.getBoundingClientRect().width) === 224 && !rail.inert && crumb === '~/home' && getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.top-bar-menu')).display === 'none'; return ok || { cats: cats.length, counts, width: rail.getBoundingClientRect().width, crumb }; })()

name: accueil-sombre-large
script: (() => { const page = document.querySelector('.page').getBoundingClientRect(); const main = document.querySelector('.shell-content').getBoundingClientRect(); return (page.width <= 1120 && Math.abs((page.left - main.left) - (main.right - page.right)) < 2) || { page: page.width, main: main.width }; })()

name: accueil-mobile
script: (() => { const tabs = [...document.querySelectorAll('.tab-bar .tab')]; const sizes = tabs.map(t => Math.round(t.getBoundingClientRect().height)); const rail = document.querySelector('.rail'); const hidden = rail.inert && rail.getBoundingClientRect().right <= 0; const status = getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.status-bar')).display; return (tabs.length === 4 && sizes.every(h => h >= 44) && hidden && status === 'none') || { tabs: tabs.length, sizes, hidden, status }; })()

name: tiroir-ouvert
script: (async () => { const menu = document.querySelector('.top-bar-menu'); menu.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); const rail = document.querySelector('.rail'); const r = rail.getBoundingClientRect(); return (!rail.inert && r.left === 0 && document.querySelector('.shell-main').inert === true && menu.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true' && rail.contains(document.activeElement)) || { left: r.left, inert: document.querySelector('.shell-main').inert, focus: document.activeElement?.className }; })()

name: tiroir-echap
script: (async () => { const menu = document.querySelector('.top-bar-menu'); menu.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); document.activeElement.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Escape', bubbles: true })); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); const rail = document.querySelector('.rail'); return (rail.inert && !document.querySelector('.shell-main').inert && document.activeElement === menu) || { inert: rail.inert, focus: document.activeElement?.className }; })()

name: tiroir-lien
script: (async () => { document.querySelector('.top-bar-menu').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); document.querySelector('.rail a[href="/categories/crypto"]').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 800)); return (location.pathname === '/categories/crypto' && document.querySelector('.rail').inert) || location.pathname; })()

name: mobile-epingles
script: (async () => { [...document.querySelectorAll('.tab-bar .tab')][3].click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); return (document.activeElement?.id === 'rail-pinned' && !document.querySelector('.rail').inert) || document.activeElement?.id; })()

name: a-propos
script: (() => { const links = [...document.querySelectorAll('.author a, .status-bar a')].map(a => a.getAttribute('href')); return (links.includes('https://github.com/KenzoPortela') && links.includes('https://kenzoportela.com') && /Kenzo Portela/.test(document.querySelector('.status-bar').textContent)) || links; })()

name: outil-base64
script: (async () => { const [src, out] = document.querySelectorAll('textarea'); src.value = 'Bonjour CyberTools'; src.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); const crumb = document.querySelector('.top-bar .crumb')?.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, ''); const active = document.querySelector('.rail .rail-item--active')?.getAttribute('href'); return (out.value === 'Qm9uam91ciBDeWJlclRvb2xz' && crumb === '~/encoding/base64-string-converter' && active === '/categories/encoding') || { out: out.value, crumb, active }; })()

name: atelier-pleine-largeur
script: (() => { const tool = document.querySelector('.tool'); const active = document.querySelector('.rail .rail-item--active')?.getAttribute('href'); return (tool.classList.contains('tool--full') && tool.getBoundingClientRect().width > 1120 && active === '/tools/recipes' && document.querySelectorAll('.rail .rail-item--active').length === 1) || { width: tool.getBoundingClientRect().width, active }; })()

name: cycle-theme
script: (async () => { localStorage.removeItem('cybertools:theme'); const btn = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => /Thème|Theme/.test(b.getAttribute('aria-label') || '')); const seen = []; for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) { btn().click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); seen.push(localStorage.getItem('cybertools:theme') + ':' + document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark')); } return seen.join(' → ') === 'light:false → dark:true → auto:false'; })()

name: bascule-langue
script: (async () => { const btn = document.querySelector('.rail-locale'); const before = btn.textContent.trim(); btn.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); const after = btn.textContent.trim(); const label = document.querySelector('#rail-workbench').textContent.trim(); btn.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); return (before === 'EN' && after === 'FR' && label === 'Atelier') || { before, after, label }; })()

name: lien-parametres
script: (async () => { document.querySelector('.settings-button').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 800)); return location.pathname === '/settings' && document.querySelector('h1')?.textContent.trim() === 'Settings'; })()

name: rail-replie
script: (async () => { document.querySelector('.rail-collapse').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); const rail = document.querySelector('.rail'); const label = rail.querySelector('a[href="/categories/crypto"] .rail-item-label'); const settings = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('cybertools:settings') || '{}'); const stored = settings.shellRailCollapsed; localStorage.setItem('cybertools:settings', JSON.stringify({ ...settings, shellRailCollapsed: false })); return (Math.round(rail.getBoundingClientRect().width) === 48 && label.textContent.trim().length > 0 && label.getBoundingClientRect().width <= 1 && stored === true) || { width: rail.getBoundingClientRect().width, stored }; })()
